stocks.title: Bank of America warns hyperscaler AI spending looks like past boom-bust cycles
stocks.detail: Strategist Sebastian Raedler points to AI capex near 3% of US GDP, rising competition and falling token prices, likening it to railroad mania and the dot-com bust. That's the bear case NVDA and QQQ carry into Monday.

stocks.title: MSCI will drop Strategy from its indexes after Nov 30 over its bitcoin-heavy balance sheet
stocks.detail: New MSCI rules on non-operating businesses target MSTR, and JPMorgan estimates about 2.8 billion in passive outflows. Shares fell 11% on the news while Saylor insists Strategy runs a real software and credit business.

stocks.title: Lockheed CEO says the surge in missile demand is permanent, not a one-time refill
stocks.detail: Jim Taiclet told CNBC demand for THAAD and Patriot interceptors will stay high as the US rebuilds stockpiles used in the Iran fighting. LMT reports later this week, so defense names have a story while tech wobbles.

stocks.title: Bitcoin drifts near 81.4K on a quiet Saturday as crypto X says it's still early
stocks.detail: BTC is roughly flat on the day, still stuck in the 81K to 83K range. Posts note under 10% of people own crypto, and Google's quantum result revived the long-run bitcoin security debate. Crypto is the live tape until Sunday.

tech.title: Google's Willow chip hits a quantum milestone with 99.99% fidelity magic states
tech.detail: Published in Science on Oct 15, Google Quantum AI cut errors about 40x versus past methods, clearing a key hurdle for error-corrected algorithms. Analysts say any real threat to bitcoin's cryptography is still far off.

tech.title: Anthropic's Erik Schluntz explains vibe coding in production after coding with a broken hand
tech.detail: He treats Claude like a dev team and acts as its product manager, prepping 15 to 20 minutes of context first. Anthropic used it for a 22,000-line merge, but he stresses humans still own architecture and testing.

tech.title: Sabi pitches a baseball cap that reads brain signals so AI can understand intent
tech.detail: CEO Rahul Chhabra says brain-computer interfaces should help AI grasp what you mean, not just type faster. The EEG cap is backed by 50 million from Khosla Ventures, with a CES 2027 demo planned.

tech.title: 3Blue1Brown's take on math careers in the AI era sparks a big debate
tech.detail: Grant Sanderson argues AI may shift credit for proofs but won't kill math's value. A comment mourning lost prestige set off replies that the joy of discovery is the real point, echoing what artists face with AI tools.

world.title: Iran says Hormuz is closed after more tanker strikes, while CENTCOM says it's open
world.detail: The IRGC claimed mine and projectile hits on supertankers; the US points to hundreds of recent transits. Independent data shows slower flows, and fishermen are hauling iPhones from a sunken cargo ship. Oil sets Sunday's futures tone.

world.title: France's cost-of-living and school protests turn violent, with over 270 arrests
world.detail: Most marches were peaceful, but crowds briefly stormed Marseille's city hall, a Lyon tourist office was looted and burned, and protesters in Grenoble even hijacked a tourist train. Authorities blame ultra-left groups.

world.title: Italian truckers and farmers blockade roads over diesel costs, emptying store shelves
world.detail: With diesel at 2.25 to 2.50 euros a liter, blockades across the south, including at Eni's Taranto refinery, left over 150 stations short of fuel. It's a real-world look at how high oil feeds into inflation and politics.

world.title: The 0-5 Chargers turn down trade calls before Sunday's game at Kansas City
world.detail: GM Joe Hortiz told teams no this week, believing the roster is close, and Khalil Mack says he wants to stay. The Chiefs host them Sunday at 3:25 PM ET. Meanwhile, Alabama at Tennessee kicks at 3:30 and Notre Dame at BYU at 7:30 tonight.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: Fishermen are pulling iPhones out of the sea near Hormuz. Wild Saturday. Chiefs at 3:25 tomorrow, TSLA Wednesday, Kent.
